id: EMO IS BACK - FREE/KOHA ENTRY-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: EMO IS BACK - FREE/KOHA ENTRY
long_description:
Do you have opinions on what REAL EMO is?? Well guess what poser, the answer is POP PUNK and METALCORE!!! Because that’s what I liked in high school!!! If you agree, or disagree, then come to Valhalla to see that stuff LIVE played by the sick and twisted FELL OFF BOY!!!!!
If we still haven’t convinced you then you can yell at us about if it was “fifth wave” (made up, not real) enough for your long ass beanie.

The amuse bouches for the evening are none other than the sad, silly cowboy clowns of GIFT HORSE, and the heart stealing, heart pumping and heart wrenching ZADIE!

Come on down for a night of funny vowel sounds, angst and eyeliner.

id: WEEZEL - THIRTY YEARS OF PINKERTON-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: WEEZEL - THIRTY YEARS OF PINKERTON
long_description:
It's been 30 years since Weezer released their seminal sophomore album Pinkerton. To celebrate the occasion, Wellington's premier (and perhaps only) Weezer cover band Weezel will be putting on a one-off show at Valhalla, performing tracks off of the cult favourite album, plus a bunch of Blue Album songs, and even a few Pinkerton B-sides to round out the set.

Sun 11th October
Valhalla, Wellington
R18, Doors 7pm

Support act TBA

name: CLAEMUS - PROTOTYPE SINGLE RELEASE
long_description:
Wellington 4 piece progressive metal band Claemus is proud to present a night of world class modern metal in support of their latest single 'Prototype'.

Joining Claemus is Whanganui's Pull Down the Sun, All I Seek and Make Dark, rounding out a showcase for the best prog metal Aotearoa has on offer.

As Claemus' one and only headline show of 2026, the band will be bringing the heat with a not-to-be-missed setlist featuring their powerful, iconic guitar and synthesizer driven music, digging deep into their back catalog as well as performing never before heard new material.

id: A NIGHT TO DISMEMBER | LUCY DIBBLE, LANDLORD SPECIAL & SYNTHIA X GHANJEE-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: A NIGHT TO DISMEMBER | LUCY DIBBLE, LANDLORD SPECIAL & SYNTHIA X GHANJEE
long_description:
One dark and stormy night, the 7th eve of October, Valhalla will open its doors for all those who dare. A bewitching night of all the local music you’ve been dying to see.

From the shadows come Wellington’s Lucy Dibble, Landlord Special, and Synthia x Ghanjee

𝔏𝔲𝔠𝔶 𝔇𝔦𝔟𝔟𝔩𝔢
With over 50,000 followers on Tik Tok, Lucy Dibble's punk-rock/pop sound inspired by 2000s artists such as Hayley Williams (Paramore), Avril Lavigne and Amy Lee (Evanescence) has taken the internet by storm. Perfectly spooky, catch her haunting and dangerous sound live at 'A Night to Dismember'.

𝔏𝔞𝔫𝔡𝔩𝔬𝔯𝔡 𝔖𝔭𝔢𝔠𝔦𝔞𝔩
If you listen closely you may hear the faint hum of a dehumidifier, or the drip of a leaky fridge. Indie rock music does not require healthy homes compliance, it requires mildew and perseverance. Landlord Special is the solo project of Leif Jasper-Owens, interpreted and performed by Ellen, Mitch, Joseph and Leif.

To start your spooky evening: 𝔖𝔶𝔫𝔱𝔥𝔦𝔞 𝔵 𝔊𝔥𝔞𝔫𝔧𝔢𝔢
Synthia x Ghanjee are a synth duo from Pōneke. They began through a shared love for dancing and dance music and manifested into a live electronic exploration. Unconfined from genre their sets can be eclectic and high in energy or tranquil and ambient. Regardless, each set is crafted to take listeners along a journey as one song and one genre alike morphs into another.

Doors - 7:30
Landlord Special - 8:00
Lucy Dibble - 8:45
Synthia x Ghanjee - 9:40

Presales here

Early Bird: $10
GA: $15
Doors: $20 [Limited]
